cohort: 62 term or near-term neonates with moderate-to-severe birth asphyxia
finding: Postnatal magnesium sulfate therapy improves short-term neurological outcomes, including earlier seizure control, faster initiation of feeding, and shorter hospital stay, in term or near-term neonates with moderate-to-severe perinatal asphyxia, but shows no significant difference in neurodevelopmental outcomes at six months.
